description: Map a data-flow description to the systems and steps that handle cardholder data, and flag unprotected handling. At the start of a PCI scoping exercise, to sketch the in-scope systems. Do not choose this when a formal assessment or a live system scan is required. Example requests: Map the PCI scope of this payment flow. | Which systems touch cardholder data here? | Flag where card data is stored unprotected.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

description.description: The customer's flow.txt, as text. Supported: Free text. The data-flow description. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_pci_scope_mapper
title: PCI scope mapper
